scope: Incremental native Blog publisher. Planning output only, not an instruction to replace existing public metadata or schema.
publicMetadata: Existing BlogPosting, RSS, sitemap, canonical and sharing paths preserved. No first article supplied or published.
performance: No new production field CWV measured. Do not claim SEO ready.

featuredImagesIncrement.scope: Incremental featured-picture selection and rendering for native Blog articles. Preserve the historical plan, its 85-point score, existing canonical routes and first article body.
featuredImagesIncrement.provenance: Eight existing licensed studio photographs; source, rights review, credits and representative-use limits recorded in docs/studio-media-sources.md.
featuredImagesIncrement.assetIdentity: Full SHA-256 of each file's bytes; byte-identical immutable copy at /blog-images/<assetId>.webp. Never overwrite a hashed asset.
featuredImagesIncrement.publicationIdentity: featuredImage.assetId and meaningful plain-text alt enter normalized preview, retry and saved-document fingerprints. The existing catalog and atomic publication journal retain version identity; image changes cannot replay an old save.
featuredImagesIncrement.rolloutOrder: Deploy image-aware code/schema/assets first and verify the complete DigitalOcean rollout; only then backfill an approved existing article image in a separate content commit. Keep its body unchanged. Reject an older editor request that omits a previously assigned image.

reader.placement: Selected picture and visible source/credit above the article title on the Blog and permanent article page.
reader.legacyCompatibility: Old documents without featuredImage remain valid and keep their prior canonical fingerprints.
reader.alternativeText: 10-250 characters, plain text, truthful to the image; no staff, client or project claims for representative photography.
reader.dimensions: Known intrinsic width and height reserve layout space; responsive sizes preserve a useful mobile crop.
reader.loading: High priority only for the main article image; lazy archive/related thumbnails.
reader.metadata: Use the actual selected image for individual article Open Graph/Twitter metadata and BlogPosting image; preserve stable article URLs and text fallback for old articles.

featuredImagesIncrement.accessBoundary: Approved local-library selection only. No file uploads, arbitrary URLs, automatic image generation, new provider, spending or environment grant. Echo publisher remains disabled pending owner activation and private cloud-browser sign-in.
verificationRequired: Reject unknown asset IDs, extra image URLs and HTML alternative text rather than silently omitting a requested image.
Verify immutable asset bytes match their filenames and recorded studio provenance.
Verify exact preview image, credit, history reopening and image-only retry conflicts.
Inspect main article and thumbnails on desktop and mobile; verify individual social metadata and BlogPosting image.
Confirm the existing first article body remains unchanged and no public test article is published.
featuredImagesIncrement.scheduledEvidence: Local image and retry checks do not prove Echo scheduled cloud-session reuse. Existing Friday task unchanged; no actual scheduled publishing proof claimed.
featuredImagesIncrement.performanceStatus: Field Core Web Vitals unmeasured; do not increase the historical score or claim SEO-ready from this increment.
